title: Git Professional Workflow Assessment
attempt_policy: Allow retries after remediation; platform policy controls attempts and records.

question_distribution.topic: History, recovery and safe change management

outcomes: Choose correct Git operations from repository state and intended effect.
Inspect commits, references and diffs to explain repository history.
Select safe recovery and collaboration strategies.
Apply security, release and automation principles with appropriate verification.
remediation: Review the linked lesson group for any missed topic; rerun the relevant practice exercise in a disposable repository and record a corrected evidence report.
status_note: Draft final assessment. Question key stays in repository-side question content and must be reviewed before publication.
